question:
Choose the word that means the same as the given word.

Brisk
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Energetic.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Brisk" means quick and lively in movement or manner; active. Its closest synonym among the options is "Energetic" (full of vigorous activity). (तेज)
◦ Example: She took a brisk (energetic) walk every morning before work.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1 "Sluggish" means slow-moving and lacking energy — the direct opposite of a brisk, lively pace.

 

• Option 3 "Lethargic" means sluggish and drowsy from lack of energy — the opposite of a quick, active manner.

 

• Option 4 "Gentle" means mild and soft in nature — describes softness of manner, not speed or liveliness.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of brisk: energetic, quick, lively, spry, vigorous. Antonyms: sluggish, lethargic, slow, languid.

question:

Jovial
solution_text:

Additional Information

• "Jovial" is most often met in the phrase "jovial mood" — a state of cheerful, hearty good humour. Synonyms: cheerful, jolly, merry, good-humoured, convivial. Antonyms: gloomy, morose, sullen, glum.

question:

• Option 2 "Honest" (truthful), Option 3 "Naive" (innocently trusting) and Option 4 "Gullible" (easily deceived) are unrelated to deliberately telling lies.

question:
Choose the word that means the same as the given word.

Blatant
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Obvious.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Blatant" means completely obvious, open, and unashamed, especially about something wrong. Its closest synonym among the options is "Obvious" (easily noticed). (स्पष्ट)
◦ Example: It was a blatant (obvious) lie, yet he repeated it without any hesitation.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1 "Subtle" means delicate and not immediately noticeable — nearly the opposite of something glaringly obvious.

 

• Option 3 "Hidden" means kept out of sight or concealed — the opposite of something openly displayed.

 

• Option 4 "Vague" means unclear or imprecise in meaning — the opposite of something starkly obvious.

 

NOTE

 

• "Blatant" is most often met in the phrase "blatant disregard" — an open, shameless refusal to follow rules or norms. Synonyms: flagrant, glaring, conspicuous, overt, unashamed. Antonyms: subtle, discreet, inconspicuous, concealed.

 

5 Important Synonyms

 

1. Fastidious (चूजी): Fussy (नुक्ताचीनी करने वाला), Particular (चयनशील), Meticulous (सूक्ष्म), Choosy (नखरैल)

 

2. Gregarious (मिलनसार): Sociable (मिलनसार), Outgoing (खुलमिजाज), Convivial (आनंदी-मिलनसार), Companionable (साथी-प्रिय)

question:

question:
Choose the word that means the same as the given word.

Quixotic
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Idealistic.

◦ Example: His quixotic (idealistic) plan to end poverty in a single year impressed no one on the finance committee.

Additional Information

 

• Option 1 "Practical" means sensible and grounded in real, workable action — the opposite of chasing impractical ideals.

• Option 3 "Pragmatic" means dealing with things sensibly and practically — the opposite of impractical idealism.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of Quixotic: idealistic, unrealistic, impractical, romantic, fanciful. Antonyms: practical, realistic, pragmatic, sensible.

2. Prolific (उत्पादक): Productive (उत्पादक), Fruitful (फलदायी), Abundant (प्रचुर), Fertile (उपजाऊ)

 

3. Meager (अल्प): Scanty (अल्प), Sparse (विरल), Insufficient (अपर्याप्त), Paltry (तुच्छ)

 

4. Ardent (उत्कट): Passionate (भावुक), Fervent (उत्कट), Eager (उत्सुक), Devoted (समर्पित)

 

5. Complacent (आत्मसंतुष्ट): Self-satisfied (आत्मसंतुष्ट), Smug (दंभी), Unconcerned (निश्चिंत), Contented (संतुष्ट)

question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word in bold in the given sentence.

The company reported a substantial increase in profits this quarter.
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Considerable.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Substantial" means large in amount, size, or importance. Its closest synonym is "Considerable". (पर्याप्त)
◦ Correct: The company reported a substantial (considerable) increase in profits this quarter.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1 "Negligible" (too small to matter), Option 2 "Insignificant" (of little importance) and Option 4 "Trivial" (of little value) are unrelated to something large or considerable in amount.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of Substantial: considerable, sizeable, ample, significant, appreciable. Antonyms: negligible, insignificant, trivial, minor.

 

5 Important Synonyms

 

1. Amicable (मैत्रीपूर्ण): Friendly (मित्रवत), Cordial (सौहार्दपूर्ण), Peaceable (शांतिप्रिय), Harmonious (सामंजस्यपूर्ण)

 

2. Brazen (ढीठ): Bold (दुस्साहसी), Shameless (निर्लज्ज), Impudent (गुस्ताख), Audacious (साहसी)

 

3. Debonair (सुरुचिपूर्ण): Charming (आकर्षक), Suave (शिष्ट), Elegant (सुरुचिपूर्ण), Gracious (विनम्र)

 

4. Effusive (अतिउत्साही): Gushing (अतिप्रवाहित), Exuberant (उमंगी), Enthusiastic (उत्साही), Demonstrative (भावप्रदर्शक)

 

5. Fickle (चंचल): Capricious (चंचल), Inconsistent (अस्थिर), Changeable (परिवर्तनशील), Erratic (अनियमित)
